{{Quote|Why'd you have to go and kill everybody? Some of those guys were all right.|Tyrodall|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Tyrodall''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who was alive during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. A partner of [[Beryl Thorne]], together they came to [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in search of the pre-bombardment artifacts. They manage to uncover some artifacts and find a way to smuggle them past Republic blockade, but Tyrodall soon grew tired of Beryl's naivety. Instead of selling all artifacts on the black market, she would return the relics to the descendants of former Tarisian residents for a much smaller fee. Not content with the loss of profits, Tyrodall faked his death at the claws of the [[rakghoul]]s and established his own operation, leaving Thorne to hers. Eventually however, his hideout was discovered and he was confronted by a [[Voidhound|smuggler]], who [[Death/Legends|killed]] him in the following firefight.
